purpose: 351 complete original NativeZipper executions of the six-tape runtime scaler. Independently computed natural product/modulus and expanded time budget. Dimension widths 0..4, factor widths 0..6, zero/one/middle/all-ones values, leading-zero and unequal widths, plus six wide/truncation cases through 32 bits. Check halt, all input/zero/output bits and markers, all six unequal absolute head positions, reusable START scratch, and every represented fuel cell blank on both sides. No free output reuse is tested or claimed.

import TransposeFollowup.DimensionScaleRun

open TransposeFollowup FixedTapeCompiler CopyMachine DimensionScale

def bits (m n : Nat) : List Bool := (List.range m).map n.testBit
def ports : List Port := [.dimension,.factor,.zero,.scratch,.fuel,.out]
def heads : Port → Int
  | .dimension => -71 | .factor => 18 | .zero => -9
  | .scratch => 113 | .fuel => -207 | .out => 46

def checkScale (l m N X : Nat) : Bool :=
  let n := bits l N
  let x := bits m X
  let nv := N%2^l
  let xv := X%2^m
  let expected := bits m (nv*xv%2^m)
  let steps := nv*(18*m+39)+14*l+6*m+44
  let c := NativeZipper.run program steps (zipperCfg start (initial n x) heads)
  decide (c.core.pc=.done) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes .dimension=Counter.marked n) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes .factor=Counter.marked x) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes .zero=Counter.marked (List.replicate m false)) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes .out=Counter.marked expected) &&
    decide ((c.core.tapes .scratch).left=[.start]) &&
    (c.core.tapes .scratch).right.all (fun s => decide (s=.blank)) &&
    (c.core.tapes .fuel).left.all (fun s => decide (s=.blank)) &&
    (c.core.tapes .fuel).right.all (fun s => decide (s=.blank)) &&
    ports.all (fun p => decide (c.pos p=heads p))

def checks : Nat × Nat := Id.run do
  let mut count := 0
  let mut failures := 0
  for l in List.range 5 do
    for m in List.range 7 do
      for N in ([0,1,3,7,2^l-1].eraseDups) do
        if N<2^l then
          for X in ([0,1,2^m/2,2^m-1].eraseDups) do
            if X<2^m then
              count := count+1
              if !checkScale l m N X then failures := failures+1
  for c in [(0,32,0,2^32-1),(32,0,1,0),(16,32,3,2^31+7),
      (32,16,1,65535),(16,16,7,32769),(4,5,31,63)] do
    count := count+1
    if !checkScale c.1 c.2.1 c.2.2.1 c.2.2.2 then failures := failures+1
  return (count,failures)

#eval checks
